==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*dьrgati||to pull, to comb (flax)?}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-дёргать.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|дёргать|impf|pf=дёрнуть}}

# to [[pull]], to [[tug]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''дёргать''' [[кто-либо|кого́-либо]] [[за]] [[рука́в]]|to pull someone's sleeve; tug at someone's sleeve}}
# to [[pull out]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''дёргать''' [[зуб]]|to pull out a tooth}}
# {{lb|ru|impersonal|colloquial}} to [[twitch]], to [[throb]], to [[twinge]]
#: {{uxi|ru|его́ всего́ '''дёргает'''|he is twitching all over}}
#: {{uxi|ru|[[у]] [[я|меня́]] '''дёргает''' [[па́лец]]|my finger throbs; I have twinges [shooting pains] in my finger}}
# to [[move]] [[sharply]], to [[jerk]]
# {{lb|ru|colloquial}} to [[disturb]]
#: {{uxi|ru|'''дёргать''' [[подчинённый|подчинённых]]|to harass one's subordinates}}
